name: Naiko Kazuko
source: Naiko is a popular online roleplayer who spends a lot of time on her laptop or phone. Due to her ASD, she can be incredibly shy, being more comfortable typing on a screen rather than talking to others. When she is online, she is hyperactive, energetic, and always willing to help newer people roleplay online.  Offline, however, she is quieter and keeps to herself.
